threadDescriptions.festival-map: Illustrate the visitor map for Lantern Steps Festival
threadDescriptions.sticker-pack: Design a set of mascot stickers for Lantern Steps Festival
threadDescriptions.usage-license: Agree and document usage rights for the festival illustrations
threadDescriptions.tablet-repair: Resolve intermittent pen pressure on the drawing tablet
threadDescriptions.invoice-round: Prepare and reconcile monthly invoices for illustration clients

items.text: Lantern Steps visitor map: show the canal entrance, three stages and accessible toilets. Deliver a landscape sheet suitable for folding.
Tablet pen pressure drops to zero halfway through strokes. Test a new nib before buying another pen.
Festival stickers: four lantern-bird poses, bold outlines and no tiny feet. These are individual cut shapes, not map icons.
Monthly billing list: Lantern Steps map 600; Kelp magazine spot 160; stickers still awaiting scope confirmation. Invoice numbers start at 600 this month.
items.rationale: Multi-client billing ledger, incidental deliverable names.

items.text: Lantern Steps draft license grants print use for this year's festival. Ask whether they also need website display and merchandise resale.
Map walk-through: canal gate is locked during performances. Put visitor entrance on Hill Lane and remove the canal entry arrow.
items.rationale: Corrects the entrance from the initial map brief.

items.text: Sticker bird looking back reads as a broken neck. Rotate the whole body and keep the beak visible in the next sheet.
600 / bird / signed? bottom unreadable
items.rationale: OCR fragment does not establish billing, art, or rights task.

items.text: New nib did not fix pressure loss. Tablet behaves normally on the borrowed laptop; send driver version and a short fault recording to support.
License reply: include festival website for one year; exclude resale of the bird stickers until the merchandise fee is agreed.
items.rationale: Defines permitted channels and unresolved rights.

items.text: Map proof printed at actual size. Toilet symbols disappear in the fold; move them five millimetres inward and enlarge the key.

Festival call decisions, recorded before I forget: finalize all four sticker poses with a white border. The sleepy bird's wing must stay inside the cut shape, and the standing one needs a wider gap between its legs so the backing does not tear. They now want to sell these at the information stall, rather than give every sheet away. Add the agreed resale permission to the illustration license, covering only this festival's printed sticker run. Any later reprint needs another discussion. Include the extra 90 merchandise fee in this month's invoice round and describe it explicitly, because their bookkeeper could otherwise mistake it for another drawing charge. Send the revised sticker proof and rights paragraph together for approval before exporting the cut files.
items.rationale: Contains concrete art, rights, and billing deliverables.

items.text: Invoice 600 is the Lantern Steps map, not an amount paid. It remains open; Kelp's 160 payment cleared this morning.
items.rationale: Reconciles monthly receivables and ambiguous number.

items.text: Support's tablet driver rollback restored pen pressure. Keep the failing version number in the ticket until two full drawing sessions pass.
Four lantern-bird stickers exported with the white cut border. Print one sheet to check the backing separates cleanly.
Signed festival license received: annual website use and the priced sticker resale clause are present. Archive the signed copy and countersign.
Hill Lane map approved after the folding test. Send the final landscape PDF and an unfolded proof image to the festival printer.
Same issue as last time. Try it without the extra bit.
items.rationale: No identifiable object or action scope.

items.text: Tablet ticket closed after two complete pressure-sensitive drawing sessions. Keep automatic driver updates off until checking the next release notes.
Month-end ledger: map invoice 600 paid, sticker invoice still outstanding including its 90 rights fee. Send one polite reminder for that balance.

undo.reason: Hypothetical undo of a map-name join; the source's objective is receivables reconciliation.
